responsibility: Implements the loop unroll-and-jam optimization pass for GIMPLE loop nests. It identifies profitable perfect nests, checks legality with loop structure, scalar-evolution, and data-dependence analysis, chooses an outer-loop unroll factor subject to dependence-distance and profitability heuristics, performs outer-loop unrolling and inner-loop fusion, updates loop-tree and exit metadata, and schedules CFG/value-numbering cleanup so jammed nests are in a form better suited for locality and vectorization gains.
